name: Munda
description: Munda is a kor warrior and ambush leader on Zendikar, nicknamed the Spider for trapping Eldrazi with ropes, and a friend and commander at Gideon's side.

bio.text: He and his band found Gideon and told him that Bala Ged had been overrun and destroyed, and a mage collapsed cliffs along Munda's iron spikes to bury Eldrazi spawn.

citations.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.
"Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

bio.text: He helped Nissa kill Eldrazi and free trapped goblins, and told them of Gideon's plan to retake Sea Gate.

citations.text: "Nissa's Quest" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2015.
"Nissa's Quest" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2015.

bio.text: At Sea Gate he told Gideon the army could not win that day, and Gideon's retreat became a rout that left Munda among the few holding off the Eldrazi.

citations.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.
"The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

bio.text: Gideon then worked out a plan with Tazri and Munda that gave every contingent a role, and Munda's troops helped build the hedron trap.

citations.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.
"Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

bio.text: After the ring failed, he and Drana's troops briefly turned the tide, and Tazri ordered him to prepare the troops to flee.

bio.text: He was among the survivors regrouped under Tazri.

citations.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

status.text: Munda survived the fighting and was last seen among the regrouped survivors arguing over a strike plan, with Nissa trusting the kor to help Zendikar recover.

citations.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.
"Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Munda and his band find Gideon and tell him that Bala Ged has been overrun and destroyed.
timeline.quote: Bala Ged, the entire continent, has be overrun and destroyed.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon holds a canyon pass against Eldrazi spawn while survivors from Bala Ged escape.
timeline.quote: Gideon planted himself in the narrow path

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: A mage collapses the cliffs with lightning along Munda's iron spikes, burying the Eldrazi spawn.
timeline.quote: sheets of white stone tumbled toward the Eldrazi below.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Munda tells Gideon a great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: "A great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate."

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Munda arrives and helps kill the swarm, and Nissa joins him in tracking the goblin.
timeline.quote: a hook on a chain rushed past her and plunged into one of the Eldrazi

citation.text: "Nissa's Quest" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Munda tells Nissa about Gideon's army and his plan to retake Sea Gate; Nissa silently disagrees with 'taking back' Zendikar.
timeline.quote: As one, we'll reclaim Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Nissa's Quest" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Munda find Pili at a hidden cave where a group of goblins is trapped, and free them; Leek is dead.
timeline.quote: Three bodies were lined up against the wall.

citation.text: "Nissa's Quest" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Tazri joins Gideon, Drana and Munda to retake Sea Gate; a failure kills many Zendikari but Sea Gate is reclaimed after training.
timeline.quote: Despite her worries, Sea Gate was reclaimed after intensive training

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saved by her halo, Tazri regroups with Noyan Dar, Drana and Munda and takes command, leading to Chandra's arrival.
timeline.quote: inspired by the angel she had killed so long ago, took command.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cut off from his army, Gideon joins Munda, who tells him the army cannot win that day.
timeline.quote: "We're not going to win this," Munda said. "Not today."

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon orders a retreat, which turns into a rout as the army dissolves, leaving Gideon, Munda and a few soldiers to hold off the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: The ordered retreat turned into a rout.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Tazri sounds a horn to rally the survivors, and the army regroups at camp as the sun sets.
timeline.quote: As the sun touched the horizon, the army of Zendikar was coming back together.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Tazri tells Gideon the battle was a disaster because he led from the front and gave his army no plan or strategy.
timeline.quote: They need to know how they fit into the army and the overall plan of attack.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes he has failed his commanders as well as his army and takes Tazri and Munda to work out a plan.
timeline.quote: "Walk with me, Tazri," he said.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Over several days Gideon meets with the commanders and builds a plan that gives every contingent a role.
timeline.quote: Over the next few days, a plan came together.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora climbs the lighthouse and enters Gideon's meeting of advisors uninvited.
timeline.quote: Her lack of invitation was clearly an oversight. She marched in.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon orders the army to build the trap and assigns commanders to patrols, telling them to keep Kiora from interfering.
timeline.quote: We will build the trap, and once we have secured our target, we will launch our offensive as planned.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Through the night Nissa and Ashaya dig up hedrons and the kor and Zendikari teams hoist them into the ring over the water.
timeline.quote: They pulled and tightened their ropes in opposite directions, slowing the hedron to a gentle stop.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: The ring fails to light because of a misaligned hedron.
timeline.quote: The ring didn't flare to life like it was supposed to.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Drana rescues Noyan Dar in mid-air, and Drana's and Munda's troops turn the tide briefly.
timeline.quote: The arrival of Drana's and Munda's troops had temporarily turned the tide of battle.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri assumes command, tells Noyan Dar to open a rift and orders Munda to prepare the troops to flee, leaving the dying behind.
timeline.quote: Munda, prepare the troops. We are getting out of here.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The titans head to Halimar Basin; the Sea Gate survivors regroup and are joined by Kiora.
timeline.quote: The survivors of the Sea Gate effort regrouped under General Tazri

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: General Tazri is saved by her halo and takes command of the regrouped forces.
timeline.quote: General Tazri was saved by the protection of her halo.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Oath of the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The four planeswalkers enter a ravine covered in Kozilek's trail and find Tazri, Munda, Jori En, Kiora and Drana's emissary arguing over a strike plan.
timeline.quote: Standing tall, bident in hand, cocky smile still in place, was the merfolk Planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Pili runs past Nissa pursued by lesser Eldrazi; Nissa, aided by Munda, kills them all.
timeline.quote: Nissa faced the creatures and, aided by Munda , killed them all.

citation.text: "Pili", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Munda dig out the trapped goblins, and Munda tells them of Gideon and the plan to reclaim Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: With careful work and patience, Nissa and Munde cleared away the cave-in, and the goblins made their way out.

citation.text: "Pili", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
